technology_name: ENCAPSULATED COMPOSITE PHASE CHANGE MATERIAL BASED NANOFLUIDS FOR HEAT TRANSFER
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional heat transfer liquids have highly restricted latent heat storage thresholds, leading to rapid system overheating or bulky cooling architectures.
description: A novel nanofluid compound featuring highly stable nano-encapsulated composite Phase Change Materials (NEPCM) with lower density profiles than water, explicitly engineered to prevent particulate agglomeration during cyclic thermal shifts.
applications: EV battery pack heat sinks, solar thermal collector arrays, high-performance climate control systems, and industrial chemical process cooling loops.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
